item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i rgyud las bskang bshags nyams gso rab skong
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bdud 'dul gsang sngags grags pa'am ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi mas gyim shod shel le rgya gar (skar) nas zla tshes bzang por rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i dus su zab gter du spyan drangs nas slar shing phag zla tshes la las ldan bla grwa mang pos bskul ngor shog ser bod yig tu phab ste drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan dang yi ge dang po'i byed pa 'gru bon g.yung drung dar rgyas nas bgyis pas gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
